thread:
deploy-bot: Starting green deployment for service-inference in eu region -> eu-central (50%) / eu-west (50%). canary route: eu-west-1a. rolling out config: enable-new-routing-anchoring=true

pagerduty: :rotating_light: PAGER: service-inference-eu-green-canary failing healthchecks (5xx) — paging Anna (on-call)

Anna: I'm on it. pulling up logs now. Miguel, can you watch routing/edge?

Miguel: saw a spike in 502s from eu-west lb to inference-backend-2. looks like header mismatch after config flip. incoming Host header becomes region-anchored.

Sam: I just saw customer telemetry: some EU customers 30-40% error rate, others fine. looks split by POP.

Eli: can we kill the new anchoring feature flag quickly? that's the risky bit.

Anna: On it. flagging feature: `feature.enable_new_routing_anchoring = false` -> rolling out now via flags-service.

Nina: FYI DNS TTL was lowered to 30s for the rollout. might be sticky caches but should flip quick.

Miguel: hold, even after flag off, some requests still route to eu-west canary and get 502. suspect stale edge routing table + sticky upstream sessions.

Sam: any chance the canary containers are running a mismatched config version (env var) that only responds with new header schema?

Anna: checking pod envs and configmaps in eu-west. `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=service-inference -o yaml`

Miguel: confirmed: canary pods in eu-west still have ENABLE_ANCHORING=true due to rollout controller not finishing.

Eli: we need to stop traffic to eu-west immediately. Can we set router weight to 0 for eu-west?

Nina: Running: `routectl set-weight region eu-west 0 && routectl set-weight region eu-central 100`

incident-bot: ACTION: route weight change requested by Nina — executing.

Anna: weight flip issued. watching metrics.

Miguel: weights changed, but I'm still seeing 15% traffic hitting eu-west because of long-lived connections and CDN anchor cookies.

Sam: can we evict sessions at the CDN edge? what's the command?

Nina: edge-ops can nuke session cookies with `edgectl purge-sessions --region eu-west --service service-inference` — running now.

Ryan: I'm taking over incident lead (shift handoff incoming) — will coordinate if Anna needs to step out.

Anna: thanks. purges running. healthchecks trending down to normal in eu-west but spikes remain.

Miguel: discovered root cause: the anchoring change added a required header `X-Anchor-Region`. old frontends didn't send it, new canary expects it and returns 502. so mismatch between frontend and canary protocol.

Eli: that explains split by POP. some frontends were upgraded earlier and worked. others weren't. bad ordering of deploys.

Zoe: customer impact: 45-minute window, degraded for ~20% of EU traffic. no data loss, higher latency and 5xxs. raising incident severity to P1 for a coordinated rollback.

Anna: I'm going to rollback the canary pods to previous image: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/service-inference-canary -n inference --to-revision=3`

Miguel: also re-enable old routing behavior until we coordinate a safe rollout plan.

Nina: feature flag already off. rolling back deployment now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for deployment/service-inference-canary at 1749991360 by Anna

Sam: monitoring metrics — 503 rate dropping; latency normalizing.

Ryan: notifying support and a subset of affected customers: Eli, can you draft a short blurb for status page? mention partial EU impact and rollback complete?

Eli: drafting: "We've identified a deployment ordering issue that caused a protocol mismatch for a subset of EU traffic. A rollback was executed and service is recovering. We're investigating and will post an update in 2 hours."

Zoe: make sure to coordinate postmortem and include rollout checklist updates and gating on frontend/backends contract.

Anna: handing off to Ryan for overnight. I'll finish logs and attach traces to the ticket.

Ryan: Taking incident. current status: rollback complete, traffic normalized, no active customer-facing errors in last 5m. ETA to close incident: 2h after postmortem plan and customer comms.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. create incident ticket? `incident create --sev P1 --service service-inference --summary "eu deploy anchoring mismatch"`

Miguel: saved heap of logs: `/var/logs/inference/eu-west/*` and traces link: https://trace.redwood/internal/trace/abc123 — attaching to ticket.

Anna: quick learnings: never enable a protocol-changing feature without strict contract/version gating and route isolation. also don't reduce DNS TTL mid-rollout unless we have session eviction strategy.

Ryan: Agreed. next steps: postmortem owner Zoe, schedule blameless review, add gating tests to CI, update runbook for kill-switches and mandatory backend handshake checks before traffic flip.

Eli: I'll post the status page update in 10m and notify support channels.

Anna: thanks all. closing channel for now, will reopen if we see regression. :white_check_mark:
